title: Ethnography And Social Structure Of Nigeria
modules: The Political Institution: East Of The Niger
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered to influence or determine the pattern of life and level of economic development."
The physical environment is considered to influence or determine the pattern of life and level of economic development.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are known to remain wet and arable all the year round."
Fadama areas are known to remain wet and arable all the year round.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a one semester 1 credit unit course."
Ethnography of Nigeria is a one semester 1 credit unit course.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to parallel and cross-cousin marriages in different forms."
Four out of the eight refers to parallel and cross-cousin marriages in different forms.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the most numerous among the pastoral ethnic groups in Nigeria."
The pastoral Fulani are the most numerous among the pastoral ethnic groups in Nigeria.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the major occupation of the Hausa, and in fact, the nature of their terrain favours intensive cultivation of grain crops (cereals), such as millet, guinea com, maize, legumes and beans."
Farming is the major occupation of the Hausa, and in fact, the nature of their terrain favours intensive cultivation of grain crops (cereals), such as millet, guinea com, maize, legumes and beans.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the absentee Fulani cattle owners who reside in the urban centres."
Included in this category are the absentee Fulani cattle owners who reside in the urban centres.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called Itibe Ekpuk, meaning literally the Royal Family."
The nucleus is called Itibe Ekpuk, meaning literally the Royal Family.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important unit in pastoral social and economic organisation."
The family is an important unit in pastoral social and economic organisation.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as the organisation of a society into subgroups, particularly those that are based on age-grades, sex, kinship, occupation, residence, property, privilege, right, obligations, authority and status."

Social organisation generally can be defined as the organisation of a society into subgroups, particularly those that are based on age-grades, sex, kinship, occupation, residence, property, privilege, right, obligations, authority and status.
fib: ______ are known to be predominantly farmers.
Yoruba as a group
The Yoruba as a group are known to be predominantly farmers.
______ are known to have developed small states of which the most prominent ones are Ibani (Bonny) Elem Kolabari (Calabar), Nembe (Brass) and Okrika.
Ijo specifically
The Ijo specifically are known to have developed small states of which the most prominent ones are Ibani (Bonny) Elem Kolabari (Calabar), Nembe (Brass) and Okrika.
______ are one of the dominant ethnic groups along the Niger- Benue complex zone.
Tiv people
The Tiv people are one of the dominant ethnic groups along the Niger- Benue complex zone.
______ is responsible for production and reproduction of goods and services.
economic institution
The economic institution is responsible for production and reproduction of goods and services.
______ is responsible for the expenses of the circumcision.
husband
The husband is responsible for the expenses of the circumcision.
______ is known of their earliest history.
Little
Little is known of their earliest history.
______ are one of the three largest groups in present Nigeria.
Igbo
The Igbo are one of the three largest groups in present Nigeria.
______ is the starting point in the discussion of inter-kinship and intergroup relations.
Marriage as we all know
Marriage as we all know is the starting point in the discussion of inter-kinship and intergroup relations.
______ is made up of a family group, which consists of men, their wives and children, sons' wives and their children.
compound
A compound is made up of a family group, which consists of men, their wives and children, sons' wives and their children.
______ is used to describe the study of the culture for a single tribe, ethnic group or society.
Ethnography in contrast
Ethnography in contrast is used to describe the study of the culture for a single tribe, ethnic group or society.
